title: Resume Redwood POC — minimal ops checklist to get trial generating
text:
Resume Redwood POC — minimal ops checklist to get trial generating

['From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood POC kickoff — post-call recap & lightweight plan

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our kickoff and a very small, operational checklist so your cloud team can get the trial producing tokens in <48 hours.

Call highlights (want to make sure we captured this):
- Goal: validate inferencing throughput for your ingestion pipeline (5–10 concurrent streams, 2k tokens/req)
- Success metric: 95th p95 latency < 400ms and cost per 1k tokens <$0.70 for the evaluation queries
- Scope: hosted Redwood Dedicated trial (isolated capacity), non-production data only

Minimal ops checklist (what we can do in parallel):
1) Provide test credentials and temporary CIDR allowlist for outbound to our ingestion endpoints — Owner: Acme network (Gabe) — ETA: 2 business days
2) Confirm a small sample dataset and a single inference route to exercise (we recommend 100k tokens/day) — Owner: Elena — ETA: 3 business days
3) Technical touchpoint (30 min): run the onboarding script, validate KV cache settings — Owner: Redwood (Monica/Karthik) — propose times below

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-playbook.pdf (step-by-step enable), acme-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (shared timeline)

Proposed times for tech touchpoint (Monica & Karthik will join):
- Tue Nov 17, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Nov 18, 14:00–14:30 PT

If you prefer, we can scope the first run to a single model and a fixed prompt set so we get telemetry immediately. Small asks here will unblock the rest of the work.

Thanks — I’ll hold the slots and can move them if Gabe or your network lead need a different window.

—
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
', 'From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood POC kickoff — lightweight ops checklist

Hi Elena —

Wanted to check whether the proposed times worked for your team or whether there are blockers from procurement or security we should route first. No problem either way — we just want to avoid the trial window expiring before you see meaningful results.

Two small asks if helpful: 1) can Gabe or your network lead share the outbound egress CIDR they prefer we test from? 2) if procurement wants a SOW, we can drop a short one-pager into DocuSign today.

Happy to jump on a 10-min sync if that’s faster.

Thanks,
Marcus

On Sun, Nov 15, 2026 at 4:20 PM Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original kickoff recap and attachments]
', 'From: Elena Ruiz <elena@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Gabe Lin <gabe@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — post-call recap & lightweight plan

Marcus — thanks for the clear plan. We did start the trial but have stalled on our side while we get a couple items through security and procurement. High level:

- Security asked for a SOC 2 summary and a simple network diagram showing which ports/hosts will be contacted.
- Procurement wants a short SOW and a named contact for billing/terms.
- Our cloud team is tied up this week; they asked for a one-page checklist to hand off.

I’m attaching the vendor security questionnaire our InfoSec uses (vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf) so you can see the fields they expect — if you can return the specific bits (SOC 2 link, cert date, team contact) we can move faster.

Can we pause the tech touchpoint for now and reconvene after we have SOC 2 and the network diagram? I’ll escalate internally but I want to be transparent — momentum has slowed.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of ML Platforms, Acme Analytics
elena@acmeanalytics.com
', 'From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — post-call recap & lightweight plan

Thanks for the note, Elena — understood and appreciate the heads-up. Quick plan to make this low-effort for your teams and get a run inside the trial window: 

1) SOC 2 & security: attaching a one-page SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and a 1-slide network-connect-guide.pdf that shows the three minimal endpoints and ports your cloud team needs to allow. That should map directly to the questionnaire you sent.
2) SOW & procurement: I’ll upload a one-page SOW to DocuSign (link below) and include a billing contact to unblock procurement.
3) Lightweight catch-up: propose a single 25-min triage purely for network/permissions (Monica + Karthik on our side). Proposed slots: Mon Nov 30 09:00 PT or Tue Dec 1 13:00 PT. If neither works, send two windows that work for Gabe.

As a small operational help, we can extend the trial quota by two weeks if you sign the SOW within 7 days — no financial commitment, just a short addendum so you can exercise the workload. If that’s useful I’ll include the addendum in the DocuSign packet.

Links & attachments:
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/to/sow-DEAL-8391
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-8391
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq-example-drive-link
- Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, network-connect-guide.pdf

If you prefer, Monica can liaise directly with your cloud lead (I’ve copied her). We’ll keep this lightweight.

—
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

CC: Monica Patel, Customer Success Engineer — will own the triage
CC: Karthik Iyer, Solutions Engineering — will join for any kernel/permission questions
']
